queries.query: SELECT X.* FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.CPY_NAME ASC) AS RN , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_CNT , A.CPY_ID , A.CPY_NAME , A.CPY_CEO_NAME , A.CPY_BUSINESS_NO , B.ADR_ZIPCODE , CONCAT(B.ADR_DESC, ' ', B.ADR_DESC2) AS ADR_DESC FROM [DOB2B-SERVER].[DoB2B].DBO.COMPANY A INNER JOIN [DOB2B-SERVER].[DoB2B].DBO.ADDRESS B ON A.ADR_ID = B.ADR_ID WHERE CST_ID = 2 AND A.CPY_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', ?, '%') ) X WHERE X.RN BETWEEN ((?-1)*10)*1 AND ?*10
